D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonPhysicalSpectrum.physicalRealOperator
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: def physicalRealOperator (m : ℕ) (b Ω : ℝ) : Module.End ℝ (RealCartesian m)

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonPhysicalSpectrum.physicalRealOperator_eq
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem physicalRealOperator_eq (m : ℕ) {b Ω : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hΩ : 0 < Ω) : physicalRealOperator m b Ω = (2 * Ω) • realOperator m

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonPhysicalSpectrum.physical_negative_eigenvalue_iff
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem physical_negative_eigenvalue_iff (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) {b Ω μ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hΩ : 0 < Ω) (hμ : μ < 0) : (physicalRealOperator m b Ω).HasEigenvalue μ ↔ ∃ k : Fin (m - 2), μ = 2 * Ω * (-positiveRoot m (k.val + 2))

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonPhysicalSpectrum.physical_positive_eigenvalue_iff
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem physical_positive_eigenvalue_iff (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) {b Ω μ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hΩ : 0 < Ω) (hμ : 0 < μ) : (physicalRealOperator m b Ω).HasEigenvalue μ ↔ ∃ k : Fin (m - 2), μ = 2 * Ω * positiveRoot m (k.val + 2)

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonPhysicalSpectrum.physical_real_dimensions
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem physical_real_dimensions (m : ℕ) [NeZero (2 * m)] (hm : 3 ≤ m) {b Ω : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hΩ : 0 < Ω) : Module.finrank ℝ (physicalStableSpace m b Ω) = 2 * (m - 2) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ (physicalUnstableSpace m b Ω) = 2 * (m - 2)

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonPhysicalSpectrum.physical_stable_exhaustive
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem physical_stable_exhaustive (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) {b Ω : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hΩ : 0 < Ω) : physicalStableSpace m b Ω = ⨆ μ : ℝ, ⨆ _ : μ < 0, (physicalRealOperator m b Ω).eigenspace μ

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonPhysicalSpectrum.physical_unstable_exhaustive
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem physical_unstable_exhaustive (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) {b Ω : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hΩ : 0 < Ω) : physicalUnstableSpace m b Ω = ⨆ μ : ℝ, ⨆ _ : 0 < μ, (physicalRealOperator m b Ω).eigenspace μ
